dogecoin.text: #Bitcoin Made things useful, #dogecoin made things fun, while #ETH gave us a chance to exist. #pussyrocket ? We decided to combine fun and useful! You want a meme token with a future? Hop on our rocket, taste the fuel, and get ready to watch earth from orbit!

#dogecoin is fun and all, but what is life without Pussies? Time for the cat to chase the dog, don't bring a leash to a rocket fight! Our rocket will fly on 15th of November, will you collect dog poop in the park, or make history as a #Pussynaut ?
